svg.title: Bohemia's named budget accounts: 2023 actual reconciles to an audited category
svg.desc: The Flood Protection Authority-East FY2025 approved budget shows FY2023 actual general-ledger Bohemia royalties account 3300 of $743,717 and Bohemia other income account 3305 of $5,784, summing to $749,501, exactly the FY2023 audited royalties, leases and permits line. The same budget shows FY2024 projected $950,000 and $13,900, and FY2025 projected zero for both. Budget estimates must not be presented as actual receipts. No private claimant payment is established.
svg.metadata: Copyright 2026 Final Vestige Studios. Original evidence crosswalk by Final Vestige Studios, November 18, 2026. Source: FPA-East, FY2025 Approved Budget, published April 1, 2024, workbook created February 28, 2024, PDF printed sections 1 p.3, 2 pp.14 and 24: https://www.floodauthority.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/FY-25-Budget_03.21.24-Board-Meeting.pdf. FY2023 audited comparison: Louisiana Legislative Auditor FY2023 report, printed p.16: https://app.lla.state.la.us/PublicReports.nsf/0/7C1A721A298CB70786258A6D00711AD7/$FILE/00003310.pdf. Artist: Final Vestige Studios. Not an archival photograph, government-issued chart, title instrument or AI-generated reconstruction. The FY2023 match is an account-level arithmetic crosswalk, not a verified bank receipt or a tract-level ledger. FY2024 and FY2025 are budgeted amounts, not reported outcomes. Use with adjacent source-credit caption.
svg.text: Bohemia revenue · FPA-East FY2025 approved budget
Exact match to the FY2023 audited category
A planning decision. Not proof that no cash arrived.
